raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
<!-- markdownlint-disable -->

## Overview

`NixlPromMetrics` and `MooncakePromMetrics` each hand-wrote the same Prometheus plumbing: one metric per stats key, one labeled child per engine, and an `observe()` that walked the stats payload. That code now lives in `KVConnectorPromMetrics`, so each connector only declares which series it publishes. Split out of #56939 at review.

The scope is these two connectors. Offloading, Mooncake store, HiSparse and HF3FS keep their own implementations.

## Claims

- A connector now publishes its series with `HistogramSpec` / `CounterSpec`; the base class registers them per engine and records the payload into them.
- Exported series, labels, buckets and values are unchanged, apart from two NIXL help strings that lose a typo (`transfers` → `transfer`, plus a stray double space).
- The bucket edges the two connectors had copied move into the shared module. A connector that needs different edges passes its own tuple.

## Validation

```bash
.venv/bin/python -m pytest tests/v1/kv_connector/unit/test_connector_prom_metrics.py \
  tests/v1/kv_connector/unit/test_nixl_stats.py \
  tests/v1/kv_connector/unit/test_mooncake_stats.py \
  tests/v1/kv_connector/unit/offloading_connector/test_metrics.py \
  tests/v1/kv_connector/unit/test_hisparse_stats.py                              # 73 passed
.venv/bin/python -m pytest tests/v1/kv_connector/unit/test_mooncake_connector.py  # 123 passed
.venv/bin/python -m pytest tests/v1/kv_connector/unit/test_multi_connector.py \
  -k "metrics or prom or stats"                                       # 17 passed, 15 deselected

pre-commit run --files vllm/distributed/kv_transfer/kv_connector/v1/metrics.py \
  vllm/distributed/kv_transfer/kv_connector/v1/nixl/stats.py \
  vllm/distributed/kv_transfer/kv_connector/v1/mooncake/stats.py \
  tests/v1/kv_connector/unit/test_connector_prom_metrics.py \
  tests/v1/kv_connector/unit/test_nixl_stats.py
```

Pre-commit passes: ruff, typos, SPDX headers, forbidden imports, mypy 3.11, and the Buildkite test-wiring check. `tests/v1/kv_connector/unit` is already in `.buildkite/test_areas/misc.yaml`, so the new files run in CI.

A real prefill/decode run on 8×H20 (Mooncake, `Qwen/Qwen3-8B`, prefiller and decoder on separate GPUs, three requests through the example proxy) exports the expected numbers from the prefiller:

| Series | After three requests |
| --- | --- |
| `vllm:mooncake_xfer_time_seconds_count` / `_sum` | 3 / 8.3 ms |
| `vllm:mooncake_bytes_transferred_sum` | 14,155,776 B |
| `vllm:mooncake_num_descriptors_sum` | 108 |
| failure counters | 0 |

The decoder shows the same series at 0: Mooncake pushes, so the histograms and failure counters are recorded on the prefiller. Repeating the run with the pre-change files gives an identical series set and identical non-timing values; only the transfer times differ (8.7 ms vs 8.3 ms).

Comparing the whole `/metrics` output against the base commit: identical except the two NIXL help strings above.

## Details

The two copies had drifted already. Mooncake summed each interval's failures before one `inc()`; NIXL incremented per event. NIXL's counter also had to merge three stats keys into one series (transfer, handshake and notification failures). Both are now ordinary declarations.

- `HistogramSpec(stats_key, name, documentation, buckets)` — one series and the stats key that feeds it.
- `CounterSpec(stats_keys, name, documentation)` — one series and the stats keys whose event counts it sums. An empty key list fails when the class body is evaluated.

The base class registers every declared series at construction and its `observe()` records a payload into them. Counter totals are unchanged: each failure event appends 1, so summing then incrementing once lands on the same value with one client call per series.

Things a reviewer may stumble on:

- The per-series attributes (`self.nixl_histogram_xfer_time`, `self.counter_mooncake_num_failed_recvs`) are gone. Nothing in the repository read them.
- `observe()` is now concrete in the base class. A subclass that declares nothing and does not override it raises `NotImplementedError`, as before.
- Stats keys stay plain strings. Every declared key is driven through the connector's own payload by the export tests in `test_nixl_stats.py` and `test_mooncake_stats.py`, so a rename fails there with a `KeyError` rather than reporting zeros at runtime.
- Connectors with other shapes keep their own code: offloading (dynamic label values), Mooncake store (`operation`/`status`), HiSparse (gauges, sampled histograms, registration behind a config flag), HF3FS (scalar counters), `MultiConnector` (dispatch only).

#55969 (open) proposes a broader declarative scheme for connectors whose stats payload describes itself. This change does not require that payload shape: it reads the existing `dict[str, list]` payloads and leaves the stats containers alone, so the two can coexist.

No open PR shares this plumbing. #56939 is merged and only adds the Mooncake series.

This change was prepared with AI assistance and reviewed line by line by the submitter.

@@ -0,0 +1,82 @@
+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright contributors to the vLLM project
+"""Contract test for the shared KV connector Prometheus registration."""
+
+import pytest
+from prometheus_client import REGISTRY, Counter, Gauge, Histogram
+
+from vllm.config import VllmConfig
+from vllm.distributed.kv_transfer.kv_connector.v1.metrics import (
+    CounterSpec,
+    HistogramSpec,
+    KVConnectorPromMetrics,
+)
+from vllm.v1.metrics.prometheus import unregister_vllm_metrics
+
+TEST_MODEL = "test-model"
+
+
+class _DeclaredPromMetrics(KVConnectorPromMetrics):
+    """Smallest subclass that relies on the shared registration."""
+
+    HISTOGRAM_SPECS = (
+        HistogramSpec(
+            stats_key="duration",
+            name="vllm:test_duration_seconds",
+            documentation="Test duration.",
+            buckets=(0.5, 1.0),
+        ),
+    )
+    COUNTER_SPECS = (
+        CounterSpec(
+            stats_keys=("failed_a", "failed_b"),
+            name="vllm:test_failed",
+            documentation="Test failures, reported through two keys.",
+        ),
+    )
+
+
+@pytest.fixture(autouse=True)
+def _clean_registry():
+    """VLLM metrics share the process-wide registry, so drop them per test."""
+    unregister_vllm_metrics()
+    yield
+    unregister_vllm_metrics()
+
+
+def _labels(engine_idx: int = 0) -> dict[str, str]:
+    return {"model_name": TEST_MODEL, "engine": str(engine_idx)}
+
+
+def _sample(series: str, engine_idx: int = 0) -> float | None:
+    return REGISTRY.get_sample_value(series, _labels(engine_idx))
+
+
+def _build(
+    metric_cls: type[KVConnectorPromMetrics],
+    per_engine_labelvalues: dict[int, list[object]],
+) -> KVConnectorPromMetrics:
+    return metric_cls(
+        vllm_config=VllmConfig(),
+        metric_types={Gauge: Gauge, Counter: Counter, Histogram: Histogram},
+        labelnames=["model_name", "engine"],
+        per_engine_labelvalues=per_engine_labelvalues,
+    )
+
+
+def test_declared_series_are_registered_before_any_observation():
+    """A declaration publishes its series at construction, so a scrape taken
+    before the first transfer still reports them, at zero."""
+    _build(_DeclaredPromMetrics, {0: [TEST_MODEL, "0"]})
+
+    assert _sample("vllm:test_duration_seconds_count") == 0
+    assert _sample("vllm:test_failed_total") == 0
+
+
+def test_a_counter_key_missing_from_the_payload_raises():
+    """Only the counter path reaches a declared key that the payload omits, so
+    a renamed event counter must surface here rather than record zero."""
+    metrics = _build(_DeclaredPromMetrics, {0: [TEST_MODEL, "0"]})
+
+    with pytest.raises(KeyError):
+        metrics.observe({"duration": []})

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright contributors to the vLLM project
+"""Prometheus metrics for the NIXL connector transfer stats."""
+
+from typing import Any
+
+import pytest
+from prometheus_client import REGISTRY, Counter, Gauge, Histogram
+
+from vllm.config import KVTransferConfig, VllmConfig
+from vllm.distributed.kv_transfer.kv_connector.v1.nixl.connector import NixlConnector
+from vllm.distributed.kv_transfer.kv_connector.v1.nixl.stats import (
+    NixlKVConnectorStats,
+    NixlPromMetrics,
+)
+from vllm.v1.metrics.prometheus import unregister_vllm_metrics
+
+TEST_MODEL = "test-model"
+
+
+@pytest.fixture(autouse=True)
+def _clean_registry():
+    """VLLM metrics share the process-wide registry, so drop them per test."""
+    unregister_vllm_metrics()
+    yield
+    unregister_vllm_metrics()
+
+
+def _labels(engine_idx: int = 0) -> dict[str, str]:
+    return {"model_name": TEST_MODEL, "engine": str(engine_idx)}
+
+
+def _sample(series: str, engine_idx: int = 0) -> float | None:
+    return REGISTRY.get_sample_value(series, _labels(engine_idx))
+
+
+def _build_prom_metrics(
+    per_engine_labelvalues: dict[int, list[object]],
+) -> NixlPromMetrics:
+    prom_metrics = NixlConnector.build_prom_metrics(
+        vllm_config=VllmConfig(
+            kv_transfer_config=KVTransferConfig(
+                kv_connector="NixlConnector", kv_role="kv_producer"
+            )
+        ),
+        metric_types={Gauge: Gauge, Counter: Counter, Histogram: Histogram},
+        labelnames=["model_name", "engine"],
+        per_engine_labelvalues=per_engine_labelvalues,
+    )
+    assert isinstance(prom_metrics, NixlPromMetrics)
+    return prom_metrics
+
+
+def _telemetry(
+    xfer_duration_s: float, post_duration_s: float, total_bytes: int, num_descs: int
+) -> Any:
+    class AttributeDict(dict):
+        __slots__ = ()
+        __getattr__ = dict.__getitem__
+        __setattr__ = dict.__setitem__
+
+    # nixlXferTelemetry is read-only and NIXL may not be installed, so feed the
+    # stats container the attributes it reads.
+    return AttributeDict(
+        xferDuration=xfer_duration_s * 1e6,
+        postDuration=post_duration_s * 1e6,
+        totalBytes=total_bytes,
+        descCount=num_descs,
+    )
+
+
+def _recorded_stats() -> dict[str, list[float | int]]:
+    """Drive the real stats container, so the keys observed below are the ones
+    the connector actually produces rather than keys restated in this test."""
+    stats = NixlKVConnectorStats()
+    stats.record_transfer(_telemetry(0.01, 0.02, total_bytes=1024, num_descs=4))
+    stats.record_transfer(_telemetry(2.0, 3.0, total_bytes=2048, num_descs=6))
+    stats.record_failed_transfer()
+    stats.record_failed_handshake()
+    stats.record_failed_notification()
+    stats.record_kv_expired_req()
+    stats.record_notification_after_expiry()
+    return stats.clone_and_reset().to_dict()
+
+
+@pytest.fixture
+def exported_series():
+    """Record one interval from the real stats container into the real registry."""
+    _build_prom_metrics({0: [TEST_MODEL, "0"]}).observe(_recorded_stats(), engine_idx=0)
+    yield
+
+
+@pytest.mark.usefixtures("exported_series")
+def test_transfer_histograms_are_exported():
+    assert _sample("vllm:nixl_xfer_time_seconds_count") == 2
+    assert _sample("vllm:nixl_xfer_time_seconds_sum") == pytest.approx(2.01)
+    assert _sample("vllm:nixl_post_time_seconds_sum") == pytest.approx(3.02)
+    assert _sample("vllm:nixl_bytes_transferred_sum") == 1024 + 2048
+    assert _sample("vllm:nixl_num_descriptors_sum") == 4 + 6
+
+
+@pytest.mark.usefixtures("exported_series")
+def test_failure_counters_are_exported():
+    # Transfer, handshake and notification failures share one counter; KV
+    # expiry and late notifications keep their own series.
+    assert _sample("vllm:nixl_num_failed_transfers_total") == 3
+    assert _sample("vllm:nixl_num_failed_notifications_total") == 1
+    assert _sample("vllm:nixl_num_kv_expired_reqs_total") == 1
+    assert _sample("vllm:nixl_num_notifications_after_expiry_total") == 1
+
+
+@pytest.mark.usefixtures("exported_series")
+def test_only_the_post_time_histogram_has_a_sub_millisecond_bucket():
+    """Post time is measured separately from the transfer itself, so it is the
+    only timing series with an edge below 5ms."""
+    post_time_edges = REGISTRY.get_sample_value(
+        "vllm:nixl_post_time_seconds_bucket", {**_labels(), "le": "0.001"}
+    )
+    xfer_time_edges = REGISTRY.get_sample_value(
+        "vllm:nixl_xfer_time_seconds_bucket", {**_labels(), "le": "0.001"}
+    )
+
+    assert post_time_edges == 0
+    assert xfer_time_edges is None

issue_comments.body: cc @zhewenl @ivanium — this is the shared-plumbing refactor that review split out of #56939, now on its own: `KVConnectorPromMetrics` takes the series each connector publishes as `HistogramSpec`/`CounterSpec` declarations, so `NixlPromMetrics` and `MooncakePromMetrics` keep only their declarations. Exported series, labels, buckets and values are unchanged (verified against the base commit, and by a real Mooncake prefill/decode run comparing both trees).
